variants.text: face; heart-shaped; forehead; moderately high, gently rounded; brow ridges; prominent; glabella; moderate width; temple; slightly narrowing; hairline; partially obscured by side-swept bangs parted on the right; cheekbones; medium-width, moderate projection and fullness; jawline; narrowing; chin; rounded, moderate projection; eyebrows; thick, soft-arched, lateral peak, moderate spacing; eyes; almond-shaped, slight upward canthal tilt, moderate palpebral fissure length, average orbital depth, defined upper-lid creases; nose; straight dorsum, moderate bridge width, rounded tip, moderate projection, narrow alar base; mouth; medium-width, thin upper lip, moderately full lower lip, level corners; philtrum; short, well-defined ridges; hair; dark, wavy, worn down, side-swept bangs.

Dark wavy hair worn down with side-swept bangs parted on the right partially obscures the hairline of this young adult with a heart-shaped face. The face features prominent brow ridges, thick soft-arched eyebrows with a lateral peak, and almond-shaped eyes with an upward canthal tilt and defined upper-lid creases. The straight nose has a rounded tip, while the medium-width mouth consists of a thin upper lip and a moderately full lower lip with a short, well-defined philtrum. The facial structure includes a moderately high forehead, medium-width cheekbones, and a jawline narrowing to a rounded, moderately projecting chin.
